items.name: sonar-ping-1
items.prompt: A single clean rounded underwater sonar ping at the start, deep resonant tone, followed by a spacious echo descending into dark water and fading for three seconds. Heard inside a submerged steel research vessel beneath thick ice. No electronic beep, shrill squeal, music, voices or animals.

items.name: sonar-ping-2
items.prompt: One low, clear underwater sonar pulse, slightly hollow and soft at the onset, with two distant diffuse returns from below and a smooth three-second decay into silence. Under ice, muffled deep water acoustics. No alarm, electronic beeping, music, speech or animal calls.

items.name: hull-hit-1-1
items.prompt: One heavy blunt creature impact against thick submerged submarine steel, a short low thud at the beginning followed by a restrained resonant hull groan decaying to silence. Interior perspective, underwater muffling. No explosion, bell, voices, music or second strike.

items.name: hull-hit-1-2
items.prompt: A single dense soft-edged body slam into a thick steel underwater vessel, bass-heavy knock and short enclosed metal resonance fading away. Close interior perspective. No ringing bell, explosion, glass, music, speech or repeated hits.

items.name: hull-hit-2-1
items.prompt: One oblique heavy strike against a submerged steel hull, a dull low clunk with a brief gritty contact and a hollow structural vibration fading to silence. Heard from inside the vessel. No explosion, bell, alarm, voices or repeated blows.

items.name: hull-hit-2-2
items.prompt: A single heavy sideways collision with thick submarine plating, muffled hollow knock, tiny abrasive onset and low steel flex resonance. Quick attack, smooth decay to silence. No high ringing, explosion, music, voices or multiple impacts.

items.name: hull-hit-3-1
items.prompt: One forceful broad creature impact beneath a submerged vessel, very low rounded boom through thick steel followed by a short creak and fading hull resonance. No explosive crack, bell, alarm, music, speech or second impact.

items.name: hull-hit-3-2
items.prompt: Single deep blunt impact on a submarine hull from below, dense thump with a slightly longer low metallic shudder decaying to silence. Underwater, close enclosed interior acoustics. No explosion, bell-like ring, music, voices or repeated strikes.

items.name: hull-scrape-1
items.prompt: One continuous low grinding scrape of thick submarine steel sliding across rough underwater rock and sand, builds briefly then releases and fades out. Dull gritty vibration heard inside the hull. No brake squeal, high screech, sparks, music, speech or repeated impacts.

items.name: hull-scrape-2
items.prompt: A single sustained abrasive contact of a submerged steel hull against gravel and stone, low coarse rumble with granular sand texture, gentle onset and release into silence. Muffled underwater interior sound. No piercing squeal, bells, explosions, music or voices.
